rights.license: Mixed -- USGS-authored content is Public Domain (17 U.S.C. §105), but NOT uniformly true for every National Map layer

notes: DELIBERATE PLACEHOLDER, not an approval of 'USGS National Map' as a whole -- this record exists specifically to document that we do NOT approve by agency, only by specific dataset (see DATA_AND_LICENSING.md 'Government data isn't automatically safe'). USGS's own copyright page confirms not all USGS-site content is public domain; third-party-sourced material can be embedded in USGS products with separate restrictions. Specific flag: the National Transportation Dataset (NTD) has historically incorporated Census TIGER/Line data plus, for certain products, commercially-licensed HERE road data -- it is NOT safe to assume NTD is uniformly public domain without checking the specific download product's metadata. The National Hydrography Dataset (NHD) looks more straightforwardly USGS-authored but was not independently spot-checked here either. Before approving any specific USGS National Map layer, create a SEPARATE, narrower registry record for that exact dataset (e.g. 'usgs-nhd', 'usgs-ntd') with its own evidence and confidence -- do not broaden this record's approval instead of narrowing it.
